IS 16137 : Part 1 : 2026 Automotive Vehicles - Methods of Measurement of Braking Coefficient of Road Surfaces - Part 1 SRTT Method
ICS 43.040.40; 93.080.01
ICS 43.040.40; 93.080.01
TED 04
TED 04
1 SCOPE
This standard (Part 1) specifies test method for measurement of longitudinal peak braking coefficient (PBC) of road surfaces using a standard reference test tyre (SRTT) primarily to be used for demonstrating compliance of the PBC to statutory requirements.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
